name: Backdraft
flavour: Breathe in. Breathe out. Stand well back.
text: Every second in the fire shoves them away from you. The breath roars bigger.
vfx: a bigger, brighter jet of flame; whatever stands in it staggers back every second
art_prompt: a wide roaring blast of orange fire blowing sideways like a gale, with curling wind streaks and flying embers
